title: Payment (DRAFT)
description: Money in, as reported by the payment provider (FIN-006). DRAFT — not approved.

providerPaymentRef.description: The provider's identifier. Unique per provider so a retried webhook cannot post the same payment twice.

feeMinorUnits.description: Provider fee, recorded separately so the ledger can show gross and net rather than quietly netting them.

_notDefinedDeliberately.cardNumber: Never. Card details go directly from the sponsor's browser to the provider's hosted checkout and never reach this platform (FIN-006).
_notDefinedDeliberately.maskedPan: Excluded too. Even a masked PAN or BIN widens PCI scope for no product benefit.
_notDefinedDeliberately.cardholderAddress: Excluded. The provider holds what it needs for fraud checks and tax.
